blocks.title: Takhleeqi salahiyat
blocks.text: Takhleeqi salahiyat naye aur asli andaaz mein sochne ki qabliyat hai, takhayyul se aam se hat kar khayalat paida karna. Yeh science aur engineering se karobar aur taleem tak har shobe mein qeemti hai.

Kai Pakistani karobar marketing mein takhleeqi salahiyat istemal karte hain: maqami brands aisi ishtihari muhimmat chalate hain jo products ki tashheer ke saath sameen se jazbati rishta bhi banati hain.

blocks.prompt: Funoon se bahar takhleeqi salahiyat ki ek misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Engineer ka pani saaf karne ka sasta tareeqa dhoondna, ya dukaandar ka delivery ka naya khayal.

items: Takhleeqi salahiyat: asli soch, har shobe mein mufeed, marketing samait.
